input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position; no redline required. Duration: the automated period check failed only because the period is spelled out in words rather than digits — "ninety days" in Section 19.2 is 90 days, which meets the >=90-day benchmark, and it runs from delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, so it is in substance longer than a bare 90 days from delivery. For the hosted component the conformance warranty runs "throughout the subscription term" (i.e., the full multi-year term under Section 8.1), which exceeds the preferred 12-month software period. Substance: 19.1 warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards plus material conformance of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications; 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance (with no functionality diminution and open-source protection). Remedy: 19.4 gives prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge and, on failure within a reasonable period, termination of the affected item with a refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims — matching the preferred repair/replace/refund remedy. Disclaimer: 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties and there is no "AS IS" walk-away risk. Recorded as internal evidence only; no comment or negotiation issue for the counterparty.
